title: Three Wisest Men
overview: Luke is expecting twins, Taylor is debating a life-changing job, and Stephan is planning a wedding — all while their mom is planning to put the family home up for sale.

title: Christmas in Tahoe
overview: To save her family hotel's Christmas show, talent booker Claire must ask for help from her ex-boyfriend Ryan, the lead guitarist of a now-famous band that fired her as their manager years ago.

title: If I Only Had Christmas
overview: At Christmas, a cheerful publicist teams up with a cynical business owner and his team to help a charity in need.
